# Brand

> One paragraph: what the business does, where, since when, for whom, and its specialisms. Facts only.

One or two sentences on how the business works (for example: who answers enquiries, and how quickly).

- Address: Street 1, 1000 AA City, Country
- Phone: +31 20 000 0000
- Email (sales): sales@example.com
- Certifications and memberships: name (certifying body), …
- Languages: English and Dutch

## Services

- [Service one](https://www.example.com/services/one/): one line of facts.
- [Service two](https://www.example.com/services/two/): one line of facts.

## Tools

- [Calculator](https://www.example.com/tools/calculator/): what it calculates and the rule it follows.

## Company

- [About](https://www.example.com/about/): history, team, certifications.
- [Contact](https://www.example.com/contact/): address, phone, quote form.

## Optional

- [Dutch version](https://www.example.com/nl/): the same pages in Dutch.
